title: Range of eliminated row entries
statement: Let $p$ be a positive natural number, and let $inv$, $piv$, and $row$ be natural numbers and finite lists of natural numbers, respectively. Every entry of the list formed by pairing the entries after the first in $row$ and $piv$ and replacing each pair $(r,y)$ by the remainder modulo $p$ of $r+p-(	ext{the first entry of }row	ext{, or }0	ext{ if }row	ext{ is empty})\,inv\, y$ is strictly less than $p$.
hypotheses_covered: $piv$ and $row$ are finite lists of natural numbers
